question: According to the Census of India 2011, identify the least literate state.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__Bihar.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The literacy rate in Bihar was** 61.8% in 2011**, which was significantly lower than the **national average of 74.04%**.
 
• The literacy rate for **men** in Bihar was **71.20%**, while the literacy rate fo**r women **was** 51.50%**.
 
• The low literacy rate in Bihar is attributed to a number of factors, including** poverty, lack of access to education, and social discrimination.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other states mentioned in the options have higher literacy rates than Bihar.

 
• The literacy rate in **Uttar Pradesh** was **67.72% in 2011.**
 
• The literacy rate in **Rajasthan **was** 66.11% in 2011.**
 
• The literacy rate in **Madhya Pradesh** was **69.32% in 2011.**
